player_prompt.intro:
O kile wa Bapadi {player_id} papadi ya HighSociety (papadi ya bapadi ba babedi).
Tsela ya papadi:  Dikari tše lesome tša seriti di rekwa ka tatelanong.
Go leka:    Ka go rekwa ga nngwe, kgetha kgethwa kgethwa kgadi ya madi ya 1-11 e bile o e senole.
            • Leka le le phagamego le wina kgetha ya seriti e bile o lahla kgadi ya madi yeo.
            • Leka le le tlasego le boloka kgadi ya madi ya yona.
            • Teko -> madi a mabedi a buswa morago e bile kgetha ya seriti yeo e rekwa gape.
Go balwa:    Ka morago ga go rekwa ga dikari tše lesome, ongeza **madi a setseng + diponto tša seriti**.
            Net-worth e kgolo e wina (tekong e feletšego -> draw).

**Sintakis ya kgato**  →  leka kgadi e tee bjalo ka '[7]' goba '[11]'.
